name: Kyonyuu Hitozuma ga Homeless no Shuudan ni Chitsunai Shasei Kyousei Rinkan
original_name: 巨乳人妻がホームレスの集団に膣内射精強制輪姦
source:
A married woman Wakako started to walk in the park for fitness every night. But there were multiple men waiting for her to appear in the park....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171127154439/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029345.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
已婚女性Wakako为了锻炼身体，开始每晚到公园散步。然而，公园里已有数名男子，正等待着她出现……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171127154439/http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029345.html]DLsite英文介绍[/url]]
